---
title: "Technology Commons Learning Web"
subtitle: "Expand a world, follow a quest path, or discover where ideas connect."
description: "An expandable graph generated from TEJ and design-and-fabrication lessons, sequences, strands, and internal links."
page-layout: full
toc: false
body-classes: "learning-worlds-page"
execute: {enabled: false}
format:
  html:
    css: ../assets/learning-map/learning-map.css
---

::: {.learning-worlds-shell data-learning-worlds="" data-manifest="../assets/learning-map/learning-graph.json" data-view="map"}

::: {.learning-worlds-intro}
::: {}
This is a **quest map for the real course website**. Start in the centre, expand one world, and open only the route you need. **Connected Web** groups related ideas; **Quest Paths** straightens them into the normal teaching sequence.
:::

::: {.learning-worlds-reminder}
**Explored ≠ mastered.** A checkmark only means that this browser selected the stop. Nothing is locked, and the map does not create a grade.
:::
:::

::: {.map-toolbar aria-label="Learning web controls"}
::: {.map-toolbar__group aria-label="View controls"}
<button type="button" class="is-active" data-view="map" aria-pressed="true">Map</button>
<button type="button" data-view="list" aria-pressed="false">Lesson list</button>
<button type="button" class="is-active" data-layout="web" aria-pressed="true">Connected web</button>
<button type="button" data-layout="path" aria-pressed="false">Quest paths</button>
:::

::: {.map-toolbar__group aria-label="Graph controls"}
<button type="button" data-focus-selected>Focus selected</button>
<button type="button" data-show-all>Show full web</button>
<button type="button" data-fit-map>Fit map</button>
<button type="button" data-reset-map>Start over</button>
<button type="button" data-reset-progress>Reset checkmarks</button>
<a href="print.html">Printable overview</a>
:::

::: {.map-toolbar__group .map-toolbar__group--wide aria-label="Search and filters"}
<label class="map-select-wrap">Course
<select data-course-filter><option value="">All courses</option></select>
</label>
<label class="map-select-wrap">Strand
<select data-strand-filter><option value="">All strands</option></select>
</label>
<label class="map-search-wrap">Find a stop
<input type="search" data-map-search placeholder="Try capacitor, Linux, logo…" autocomplete="off">
<span class="map-search-results" data-search-results hidden></span>
</label>
:::
:::

<p class="map-status" data-map-status role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading the learning web…</p>

::: {.map-layout}
<div class="learning-map-stage" aria-label="Expandable learning graph">
  <svg class="learning-graph" data-graph-svg role="application" aria-label="Learning graph. Select nodes with a pointer or keyboard. Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag the background to pan.">
    <defs data-graph-defs></defs>
    <g data-graph-viewport>
      <g data-edge-layer aria-hidden="true"></g>
      <g data-node-layer></g>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <p class="learning-map-help">Select a node for details. Double-select a world or strand to expand it. Drag to pan; use the mouse wheel to zoom.</p>
</div>

<aside class="map-detail" data-node-detail aria-live="polite" aria-label="Selected learning stop">
  <h2>Technology Commons</h2>
  <p>The graph is loading. The normal course navigation remains available.</p>
</aside>
:::

<div class="map-list-view" data-map-list aria-label="All lessons by strand"></div>

::: {.map-legend aria-label="Connection legend"}
<span>Thick line: next lesson</span>
<span>Thin line: belongs to this strand</span>
<span>Dashed curve: related page link</span>
<span>Blended node: connects more than one strand</span>
<span>+ / −: expandable region</span>
<span>✓: explored on this browser</span>
:::

::: {.source-note}
The interactive graph is generated from the same course sequence that powers the normal lesson navigation. Links written inside lesson pages add cross-connections. The existing [printable overview](print.qmd) remains a compact paper map.
:::

<noscript>
JavaScript is required for the expandable graph. Use the [TEJ course notes](../tej3-4/index.qmd), [Design and Fabrication notes](../design-fabrication/index.qmd), or the [printable overview](print.qmd).
</noscript>

:::

<script src="../assets/learning-map/learning-map.js" defer></script>
